svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a thick violet resist layer with a flat top covers the whole slice: two thick metal shapes under a thin pale film. After it the resist is gone and the thin pale film over the metal shapes and the floor between them is unchanged.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a thick violet resist layer with a flat top covers the whole slice: two thick metal shapes under a thin pale film. After it the resist is gone and the thin pale film over the metal shapes and the floor between them is unchanged.
svg.text: The seal opening is etched at the die edge,
outside this slice; the resist is stripped.
After: the resist stripped; no change in this slice
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
